title: Quick German Oat Fritters
description: Easy-to-make German-inspired fritters made with oats, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. Serve warm with a side of fruit or yogurt.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together oats, quick oats, water, flaxseed meal, sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a non-stick pan with vegan oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the oat mixture into the pan.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of fruit or yogurt.
